pages.text: The parcel is warmer at the binding than at its centre. Its seal agrees with the mark on this charter.
pages.title: Sealed cargo
The seal
pages.text: A recovery objective issues cargo at its named checkpoint. Keep it with you and bring it to extraction. A parcel from another journey cannot settle this contract.

pages.title: Bring the object
pages.text: A written record is no substitute for the cargo. If it is lost, retrieve it before attempting to leave. A required recovery remains unfinished without the object.

pages.title: Bring the object
pages.text: Successful extraction takes the sealed parcel and records its delivery. Loose samples and equipment are yours to bring home.
